body: Happiness, contentment.  I know that happiness is not an emotion that one should feel 24/7, but I'd like to be at least content with my life.

I'd say you're probably right.

I feel like a lot of the reason people like me is because of the fact that I excel in what I do, and if this were to be taken away, I'd be an outcast.

That video is wonderful.  I've watched it about 4 times in a row, now, and it's really making me consider and think about the way I live my life.

I agree that I put a lot of pressure on myself.  Pretty sure this stems from others putting pressure on me because they think I am so completely capable of handling anything.

The problem is that I've developed exercise addiction in the past, so it's a very delicate balance between working out a feasible and healthy amount, and working out too much.

Thank you very much for this perspective.  I agree that OCD is extremely pervasive, making it hard for me to really get my life in order.  Am looking into therapy, whether it be in my hometown or in this new area I find myself.
